feed.title: Mercato Grove now posts a special
feed.body: Read today on mercatogrove.com: up to 6 weeks free base rent plus one welcome perk (6 months free garage parking, a $1,000 move in credit, or 6 months free storage and bike parking plus a $300 gift card). ex.q: Where do we stand out against rivals?
ex.a:
From the Montage website: pool and spa, sky lounge, golf simulator game room, dog park and indoor pet spa, guest suite, private garages with direct hallway access, and EV charging.
  • Deposit: $400 vs $500 at The Overland and Mercato Grove (The Steward is also $400).
  • Pet rent: $35 a month vs $50 at The Overland and $55 at Mercato Grove, with no pet fee and up to 3 pets.
  • Google rating: 4.7, the highest of the 4.
ex.s: Montage and rival websites · checked 11/27, Google scan 11/20

ex.q: Who showed the tour? Pending service requests?
ex.a: Tour agents and service requests live in your property management system, which is not connected to this app. Tours you log in Tour mode are on your desk list.

We cannot see each person’s reason, but here is what they see when they compare you:
  • The Overland lists 1 beds from $1,466. Montage 1 beds start at $1,795, below The Steward ($1,949) and Mercato Grove ($1,985).
  • The Overland adds up to 6 weeks free on select homes. Your 2 months free is on select 2 bedrooms only.
  • The Steward lists 2 beds from $1,899 vs your $2,150.
What wins them back: the 2 months free plus $1,000 Look and Lease on 2 beds (ends Nov 30), the $400 deposit, $35 pet rent and the 4.7 rating.

The Overland: up to 6 weeks free. The Steward: free rent on qualifying new leases, amount not posted. Mercato Grove: up to 6 weeks free plus one welcome perk. Montage: select 2 bedrooms get 2 months free plus a $1,000 Look and Lease bonus, ending Nov 30.

ex.q: Where do our leads come from?
ex.a:
Completed website forms from these 7 sources in 4 weeks:
  • Google search: 24 leads from 725 visits
  • Direct (typed or saved): 13 from 381
  • Google Ads: 10 from 1,074
  • Zillow: 2 from 44
  • ChatGPT: 1 from 43
  • Bing: 0 from 46
  • Facebook ads: 0 from 280
Calls and walk ins are not counted here.
ex.s: Website visits and completed forms · Oct 26 to Nov 22

ex.q: How is our Google listing doing?
ex.a: Renters saw the listing 4,239 times. It drove 552 direction requests, 479 website clicks and 59 call button taps.

4.7 stars from 34 Google reviews, the highest rating of the 4. The Steward 4.6 (35), Mercato Grove 4.4 (87), The Overland 4.0 (61). 1 new Montage review in the last 4 weeks, so every review request counts.
